head: ChangeLens Earth: satellite before and after app for any place
dek: ChangeLens Earth lets you pick any place and two dates, then drag a divider across free satellite images to see what changed, from a new neighborhood to a shrinking glacier. The $0.99 iPhone and iPad app was #54 among paid Navigation apps on the US App Store on 25 November.
details: It uses Copernicus Sentinel-2 images, plus Sentinel-1 radar that sees through cloud, and frames a 1, 3 or 10 km square found by name, address or coordinates. You can switch between true color, a vegetation and water layer, radar and a blend, then save or share the comparison with dates and a scale bar. Optional Place Packs of ready-made sites are one-time purchases; there's no account, no ads and no location request. It's made by developer Marshall Tyler Frith and came out on 27 October.
where: iPhone and iPad, $0.99 with optional one-time Place Packs
means: If you're curious how your town, a coastline or a building site has changed over the years, this shows it side by side for under a dollar.
todo: Search a place you know, pick an older Before date and a recent After date, and drag the divider. If a date is cloudy, the app jumps to the nearest clear image and tells you.
